Sections.title: White Point standards - Plat QA and Submission

items.title: Independent Plat Computations
items.statement: Independently close boundary, lots, tracts, rights-of-way, and easements; reconcile areas, curves, and shared lines.

items.title: Plat Submission Requirements
items.statement: Verify current local application, sheet size, approval process, required certificates, fees, and supporting documents.

items.title: Recording Readiness
items.statement: Confirm current clerk acceptance requirements and required approval evidence before recording.

items.title: Plat Package Consistency
items.statement: Reconcile final plat, title documents, survey, dedication, supporting exhibits, and revision responses.

items.title: Monumentation Follow-Up
items.statement: Track any permitted deferred monument installation, responsible party, deadline, and completion evidence.
